raw.details:
Overview

From Idea to MVP | Build. Demo. Win.

  • Total Prize Pool Worth ₹25,000 
  • 2-Month Remote Internship Opportunity for Winners

Have an innovative idea? Turn it into a working product with MST Blockchain!

MST Blockchain BUILDATHON #2 is an open innovation challenge for students, developers, founders, and technology enthusiasts who want to build real-world solutions using blockchain, AI, Web3, and emerging technologies.

This is not a traditional 24-hour hackathon. Participants get dedicated time to develop their ideas into working prototypes, validate their solutions, and demonstrate what they have built.

The challenge follows three stages: Idea Submission, Build Sprint, and Offline Demo Day. Only the top 15 teams will qualify to showcase their projects at the MST Blockchain office.

Challenge Tracks

Participants can build innovative solutions across the following areas:

  • Blockchain and Web3: Decentralized applications, on-chain verification, digital identity, and trust infrastructure.
  • AI and Autonomous Agents: AI-powered applications, agentic workflows, and intelligent automation.
  • Smart Contracts and DeFi: Practical blockchain applications and decentralized financial tools.
  • Developer Tools: SDKs, APIs, infrastructure, and tools that simplify blockchain development.
  • Real-World Applications: Solutions for education, governance, supply chains, healthcare administration, and other meaningful problems.

Projects demonstrating meaningful integration with MST Blockchain infrastructure are especially encouraged.

Final Round: MST Demo Day

Date: 1 November 2026

The top 15 finalist teams will be invited to present their working products at the MST Blockchain office. Finalists should plan their travel accordingly.

Venue

Masterstroke Technosoft Pvt. Ltd. (MST Blockchain)
Kohinoor World Tower, Tower 3, Office 403
Pimpri, Pune, Maharashtra, India

Finalists will demonstrate their products, explain their technical implementation, answer questions from the judges, and compete for prizes and winner benefits.

Please note that the final Demo Day is an offline event. Shortlisted finalists must be available to attend in person.

Prize Pool and Winner Benefits

Total Prize Pool: ₹25,000

  • ₹5,000 in cash prizes for the winners.
  • ₹20,000 worth of rewards and goodies for winning teams and participants, as determined by the organizers.
  • 2-Month Remote Internship : Winners will have the opportunity to participate in a two-month remote internship with MST Blockchain, gaining exposure to industry workflows, technology development, and practical project experience.

The cash prizes, rewards, and internship opportunities will be distributed or offered according to the final decisions of the organizing team.

Who Can Participate?

This challenge is open to:

  • College students and university teams.
  • Freshers and aspiring developers.
  • Blockchain and Web3 developers.
  • AI and software developers.
  • Startup founders and early-stage teams.
  • Independent builders and technology enthusiasts.

Participants can register individually or in teams of up to 4 members.

Ready to Build?

Have an idea worth bringing to life? Join MST Blockchain BUILDATHON #2 and show us what you can build.

Build it. Demo it. Win rewards. Build the future with MST Blockchain.
